mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ads ( title, subtitle, link, image_url, active ) VALUES ( BTRIM(#{title}), #{subtitle}, #{link}, #{imageUrl}, #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ads SET title = BTRIM(#{title}), subtitle = #{subtitle}, link = #{link}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{adsId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ads ORDER BY id DESC
